Q8245.reason: The absolute threshold is defined as the lowest intensity detected by approximately 50% of observers; at 70%, exactly half (15 out of 30) responded.

Q8128.reason: Exercise-induced cough and congestion with normal spirometry in a patient with an asthmatic family history is classic for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction.

Q5479.reason: The defendant was guilty of solicitation because the victim accepted and agreed to commit the crime before renunciation occurred; conspiracy requires a mutual agreement which is often debated when one party feigns intent.
